name: Neuralink
description: Neuralink is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Neuralink is a privately held neurotechnology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $650 million Series E round announced on June 2, 2025, was reported to value the company at $9 billion before the new investment.

Founded in 2016 and based in Austin, Texas, Neuralink develops implantable brain-computer interfaces, which translate neural signals into commands for computers and other devices. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Neuralink has not disclosed its valuations; the Series E figure is pre-money, as reported by Semafor. The Series D amount includes $43 million raised in addition to the $280 million Neuralink announced in August 2023, as shown in a later SEC filing.
round_notes: Neuralink did not name a lead investor for its Series E. In January 2026, the company said 21 participants were enrolled in its clinical trials worldwide; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Neuralink's Series E included ARK Invest, DFJ Growth, Founders Fund, G42, Human Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, the Qatar Investment Authority, Sequoia Capital, Thrive Capital, Valor Equity Partners and Vy Capital. Founders Fund led the Series D, and Vy Capital led the Series C. Other investors include GV, Craft Ventures and Gigafund.
spv_sentence: Since 2022, 12 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Neuralink have filed with the SEC, two of them in 2026.
funds: Two SEC-registered funds report positions in Neuralink. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 237,624 shares, which it valued at $18.2 million, or $76.62 per share.
sources: Sources: Neuralink's announcements of its Series E, Series D and Series C and its January 2026 update; TechCrunch reports dated June 2, 2025 and November 25, 2023; Semafor (May 2025); Fortune (January 2022); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
